patch_description: The current two-hop terms can accumulate across all \(n-2\) intermediate nodes for each OD pair, so their combined influence may greatly exceed that pair’s direct-link reward. Keep the existing path-quality ranking, but rescale the terms for each OD pair together when their total magnitude exceeds 50% of its linear reward. This limits aggregate two-hop influence without changing which intermediate paths are preferred, and leaves OD pairs with no direct demand without two-hop rewards.
